outcome: Composite maternal morbidity (hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, gestational diabetes mellitus)
Composite adverse neonatal outcome (stillbirth, intraventricular hemorrhage, hypoglycemia, respiratory distress syndrome, APGAR <7 at 5 min, NICU admission)
finding: Higher prepregnancy BMI class was significantly associated with an increased risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, gestational diabetes mellitus, induction of labor, cesarean delivery, composite adverse neonatal outcomes, and macrosomia, while decreasing the risk of fetal growth restriction.
mod_finding: Increased BMI was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, but specific values not provided
